matches.preview: The model strongly favours Sheffield United at home, giving them a 67% chance of victory, compared with 21% for the draw and 12% for Bolton Wanderers. Sheffield United won three of their final six league matches last season, including a 2-1 win at Derby on 2 May, although they also lost consecutive home games to Preston and Blackburn. Bolton’s listed sequence is history from April and May 2019; the club is returning to this level after time outside the top two divisions. Sheffield United also won three of the four recent meetings. The total-goals view is very narrow, leaning over 2.5 at 51% against under 2.5 at 49%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明顯看好主場作戰的 Sheffield United，認為其勝率為 67%，平局機率為 21%，Bolton Wanderers 的勝率則為 12%。Sheffield United 上賽季最後六場聯賽贏得三場，包括 5 月 2 日作客以 2 比 1 擊敗 Derby，但也曾連續在主場敗給 Preston 與 Blackburn。Bolton 所列的賽果紀錄來自 2019 年 4 月與 5 月，該隊在離開前兩級聯賽一段時間後，如今回到這個級別。Sheffield United 在近期四次交手中也贏得三場。總進球數的預測非常接近，超過 2.5 球為 51%，低於 2.5 球為 49%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 makes this a finely balanced match, with a slight preference for Preston North End at 38%. Bristol City are close behind at 34%, while the draw is rated at 28%. The closing results from last season offer mixed evidence: Preston lost 3-1 at home to Southampton after winning 3-2 at Sheffield United, while Bristol City finished with a 2-0 home win over Stoke. Preston also took four points from last season’s two meetings, winning 2-0 away before a 0-0 home draw. The total-goals lean is under 2.5 at 55%, compared with 45% for over 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90認為本場比賽實力相當，Preston North End略占優勢，勝率為38%。Bristol City以34%緊追在後，平局機率則為28%。上季末段的賽果提供了不同面向的參考：Preston在主場以1比3不敵Southampton，此前則在客場以3比2擊敗Sheffield United；Bristol City則以主場2比0擊敗Stoke作收。Preston上季兩度交手共取得4分，先在客場以2比0獲勝，之後於主場以0比0戰平。總進球數方面，低於2．5球的機率為55%，高於2．5球則為45%。
